STRATA TITLES ACT 1985
Strata title S ( amendment  of fifth  S chedule ) order  2021
in exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 4 a(4) of the Strata Titles
Act 1985 [Act 318], the Minister, with the approval of the National Land
Council, makes the following order:
Citation and commencement
1. (1)  This order may be cited as the Strata Titles (Amendment of Fifth
Schedule) Order 2021.
  (2)  This Order comes into operation on 1 April 2021.
Amendment of Fifth Schedule
